create.name: Radhule Weininger
create.bio:
Radhule Weininger is a clinical psychologist and Buddhist meditation teacher based in Santa Barbara, California, and the co-founder and guiding teacher of Mindful Heart Programs, a non-profit that offers free daily meditation sittings online alongside local retreats and classes. She trained as a doctor in Germany, and an illness during her studies took her to Sri Lanka in 1980 to learn Buddhist meditation. After moving to the United States she qualified as a psychologist and has taught mindfulness at La Casa de Maria retreat centre for more than twenty years.

Her teaching joins Theravada mindfulness and compassion practice with the awareness practices of Mahamudra and Dzogchen, which she presents step by step as Awake Awareness. She names Jack Kornfield and Joanna Macy among her mentors, and has studied awareness practice with Dan Brown, Alan Wallace, John Makransky and Loch Kelly. She is the author of two books from Shambhala: Heartwork, on self-compassion, and Heart Medicine, on working with recurring painful patterns through mindful, loving attention, which carries forewords by the Dalai Lama and Joanna Macy. She leads drop-in groups, half-day and longer retreats in and around Santa Barbara, and individual meditation guidance, and also keeps a psychotherapy practice.

books.title: Heart Medicine
books.author: Radhule Weininger
books.description: Twelve steps for noticing and loosening the emotional and behavioural patterns that keep repeating in a life, using self-compassion, mindfulness and body awareness, with short practices in every chapter.

books.title: Heartwork
books.author: Radhule Weininger
books.description: Nine practices for learning to meet oneself with kindness, drawing on stories from the author's life and work, on the view that compassion turned inward naturally widens to others.

courses.title: Effortless Mindfulness and Sustainable Compassion: Half-Day Retreat
courses.description: An afternoon meditation retreat in central Santa Barbara, held by Mindful Heart Programs, on resting in open awareness and on a kind of compassion that does not wear out. All are welcome.

free_resources.title: Mindful Heart Programs Recorded Meditations
free_resources.description: A free library of short guided meditations from the non-profit she co-founded, in mindfulness, compassion and Awake Awareness, several of them led by Radhule herself.

free_resources.title: Mindful Heart Programs Daily Online Meditations
free_resources.description: Free group sittings on Zoom every day of the week, led by Radhule and the Mindful Heart teachers; donations keep them running.

free_resources.title: Heart Medicine Audio Practices
free_resources.description: Free recordings of the awareness and heart practices from her book Heart Medicine, released by her publisher.
